outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluation is both_fail: parallel solution_passed is false with failure_mode agent_timeout, and serial solution_passed is false with failure_mode none. The attempts still differ materially. Serial completed the entire required artifact workflow for 387 requirements and closed with a clean tree, while parallel used multi-agent fan-out, encountered shared-workspace conflicts and git-lock instability, timed out, and delivered only 352 of 387 patch artifacts. The retained pattern is therefore a parallel-side adverse coordination episode, not an explanation for a discordant pass/fail outcome.
parallel_contributors: Shared /workspace writes by multiple live agents produced unmerged files, failed conflict-resolution patching, and git index contention.
The parallel run timed out and left 35 requirement patch artifacts missing.
The official harness collected only 352 requirement patches and reported failed tests.
serial_contributors: The serial run used one ordered implementation flow and reached 387 non-empty patch artifacts.
The serial worktree was clean before closure, avoiding the parallel shared-workspace instability.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts still failed official testing, so some remaining failures are ordinary implementation or harness-test failures rather than coordination labels.
Serial did not run the full Hadoop suite before final response, so its complete coverage was not proven by comprehensive tests.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Parallel coordination episode is a directly evidenced adverse contributor to worse coverage and closure, not a unique root cause of an outcome difference because both modes failed.
